story.title: Ethiopia and Eritrea Cut Diplomatic Ties Amid Tigray Conflict Escalation
story.summary: Ethiopia has severed diplomatic ties with Eritrea, accusing it of supporting the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF), which has been launching attacks into Ethiopia's Afar and Amhara regions. As part of this diplomatic fallout, Ethiopia announced the expulsion of 10 Eritrean diplomats and the closure of its embassy in Asmara. In response, Eritrea has also cut all diplomatic ties with Ethiopia following these developments.

related_stories.title: Christa Pike Survives Botched Execution Attempt in Tennessee, Raising Death Penalty Concerns
related_stories.summary: Christa Pike, a death row inmate in Tennessee, survived a botched execution attempt involving two doses of lethal injection. Following the incident, she was reported to be in critical condition at a hospital. The failed execution has sparked renewed debate over the use of lethal injections in the U.S. and raised questions about the state's ability to carry out executions effectively.

related_stories.summary: Capt. Smit Machchhar, recovering in a hospital, described his harrowing experience during an attack on a Flydubai flight. He recounted how he fought to regain control of the cockpit, realizing that if he did not act, the passengers' lives were at risk. His actions, which included opening the cockpit door to allow passengers to assist, have led to him being hailed as a hero.

related_stories.summary: Gypsy Rose Blanchard has spoken out following the death of her ex-fiancé, Ken Urker, who was found dead at his home in Louisiana. Urker, who was 34 years old, reportedly struggled with personal issues before his passing. Blanchard and Urker met while she was incarcerated for the murder of her mother, Dee Dee Blanchard.
